test_objective: Check that you cannot query context source registrations, if neither Entity types nor Attribute names are provided, an error of type 400 shall be raised.

test_cases.name: 037_02_01 Query Context Source Registrations Without Entity Types and Attribute Names
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot query context source registrations, if neither Entity types nor Attribute names are provided, an error of type 400 shall be raised.
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Temporal Representation of Entity and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
